title: Reason Code 112: the remote RADIUS server rejected the request
plain_english: This NPS acted as a proxy: a connection request policy forwarded the request to a remote RADIUS server group, and that server answered Access-Reject. The local event only tells you the forward happened. The actual reason lives on the remote server.

any: remote server rejected the connection request

causes.cause: The remote server denied the user for its own reason (credentials, policy, account state).
causes.next_check: On the remote server, find the 6273 event (or FreeRADIUS -X output) for the same account and timestamp and paste that here.

causes.cause: The connection request policy forwards to the wrong server group, or strips/keeps the realm in a way the remote server does not expect.
causes.next_check: NPS console > Connection Request Policies > the policy named in the event > Settings > Authentication (forwarding target) and Attribute manipulation (User-Name rules).
